scope: Actual Windows pair-publication failure and recovery; media fidelity remains a separate gate
observer: Root agent; execution details recorded from the original tool outputs
failure: EPERM while replacing .tmp/paired-full.mp4; the prior owned review server held the alias open
failurePreservation: Both old hashes matched their preserved first-candidate copies after the failed attempts. No prior generation was deleted.
recovery: Verified the old listener PID21844 and exact review-server.mjs command before stopping that owned server. Its command used an ephemeral port, so no literal port argument was present. The third pair build succeeded; a new owned server PID27428 listens on59028 and pins the immutable generation in memory.
limitations: The EPERM observations are historical tool-output evidence; this note does not claim a new induced live failure or a visual PASS. The separately executed fixture guard tests publication failures with mocked media.
